_readme: THE STRENGTHS TABLE SHIPPED WITH THE PRODUCT. For a kind of work a step
declares (`kind`), the engines to try first, in order, across companies;
the chain the flow wrote follows them. A kind without a row falls to the
chain as written. ~/.config/sailor/strengths.json replaces this file whole.
`measured_on` says what the rows rest on. Until the ledger has enough
calls per kind to say who did what at what cost, they rest on the mandate
of 02/09/2026: mechanical work local, research reads on the free models,
implementation and judgement on the paid subscriptions.
measured_on: the mandate of 02/09/2026; no ledger measure per kind yet
